findings.text: Change of character (#1919): The verb "want" carries several different faces in these verses: a will that wants the good and cannot do it (Rom 7); a will asked out by Jesus; a will made absolute; a will bent to a crowd; a will taken up and turned ("If anyone would be first"); a will that turns back toward slavery (Gal 4:9); Willing God's will comes before knowing it (Joh 7:17). The faces are woven as Ch 11 §4, *Whose will, and whether it can carry itself out*.
